model: INMBSMIT001I000 Mitsubishi Electric AC to Modbus RTU gateway
applies_to: One Mitsubishi Electric Domestic, Mr. Slim or City Multi indoor unit via INMBSMIT001I000, user manual r2.8 (11/2024).
summary: Modbus RTU server that connects to the CN105 port of a single Mitsubishi Electric indoor unit. Points are 16-bit holding registers for on/off, mode, fan, vane, setpoint, room temperature, alarm and error code, with window-contact and external-temperature (virtual temperature) features.

addressing.note: Each table gives a 'protocol address' (base 0) and a 'PLC address' (base 1). The protocol address is the wire address and is used for 'documented'.

source.title: Intesis INMBSMIT001I000 Modbus RTU (EIA-485) Interface for Mitsubishi Electric air conditioners - User's Manual
source.pages: pp. 8-15 (register tables pp. 8-10, DIP switches pp. 13-15)

notes: Every register is documented as a 16-bit unsigned holding register and no temperature range in the manual goes below zero, so temperatures are UINT16. The 'no value' marker the manual writes as -32768 is raw 0x8000 (32768) and is listed as an enum entry. Registers 4 and 5 print the marker as -32678, an apparent typo, so no enum is given there.

Temperature registers depend on DIP SW4: x1 °C, x10 °C (decidegrees) or °F (no °F x10). The register-table footnote calls x10 the default, but the SW4 table and the quick-start page (all other switches off) give x1 °C as the factory setting, so scale 1 / °C is used. Read SW4 position 1-2 on site: if x10 is set use scale 0.1; if °F is set the values are whole °F.
Error code enum (Mitsubishi codes) not reproduced; see manual section 7.

registers.name: AC unit mode
registers.description: Available modes depend on the indoor unit.

registers.name: AC unit fan speed
registers.description: Available speeds depend on unit and SW1 setting.

registers.name: AC unit vane position
registers.description: Available positions depend on the indoor unit.

registers.name: AC unit temperature reference
registers.description: Unit room temperature, 10..38 °C. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: Window contact
registers.description: Virtual window contact written from Modbus.

registers.name: Gateway disablement
registers.description: Stops the gateway passing commands; stored in NVM.

registers.name: AC remote control disablement
registers.description: Blocks the unit's remote control; stored in NVM.

registers.name: AC unit operation time
registers.description: Hours the unit has been on; stored in NVM.

registers.name: Error code
registers.description: Mitsubishi error number (manual section 7); 65535 = no comms with AC unit.

values.65535: Communication error with the AC unit

registers.name: Open window switch-off timeout
registers.description: Countdown after window opens before switch-off (0..30, default 30).

registers.name: Modbus RTU baud rate
registers.description: Baud rate in use (set on DIP switches).

registers.name: External ambient temperature (Modbus)
registers.description: Room temperature written from Modbus (virtual temperature). SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

values.32768: Not initialised / no value (0x8000; manual writes -32768)

registers.name: AC real setpoint temperature
registers.description: Setpoint actually applied in the indoor unit. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: Block periodic sendings
registers.description: 1 = only forward Modbus writes that change the value (FW 2.1+).

integration.summary: Set the address on SW3 and the baud on SW3/SW4, set SW1 to match the unit's fan speeds, power-cycle, then read holding registers 0-11 with function 03 and write with 06. Confirm the temperature scale on SW4 first.
integration.enable: No enable step; register 7 (gateway disablement) must be 0 for commands to reach the unit.
quirks: Temperature scale depends on DIP SW4 and the manual is inconsistent about the factory default (x1 vs x10).
Function 16 is accepted only with a quantity of one register.
setup: SW3 positions 1-6: slave address. SW3 positions 7-8 with SW4 position 3: baud (9600 default).
SW1: number of fan speeds / vane features of the indoor unit.
DIP changes need a power cycle; the gateway only talks once the AC unit is powered.
gotchas: Writing register 22 enables virtual temperature: the Mitsubishi remote can no longer change the setpoint.
Error code 65535 means the gateway lost the indoor unit.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
